annotation.bound_parties_text: The relevant departments and local authorities are directed to strengthen coordination, intensify policy support and implement the measures; the Ministry of Commerce is to establish a working mechanism.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 各有关部门要强化协同配合，加大政策支持力度，形成工作合力。各地相关部门要因地制宜，加大创新探索力度，推动各项措施落实落地。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 商务部等8部门关于加快“人工智能+消费”发展的实施意见 商建发2026年第89号
